description: Multiclass softmax loss from paper §3.2 Eq. (3), using the greatest class probability strictly below the true-class probability; the official implementation uses zero when no strictly lower probability exists (dual_focal_loss.py:22-30). Class-index shapes and reduction behavior follow the project loss convention (src/topologies/implementations/training/core.py:116-135).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": int(features[:3].argmax())}
ds = synth.Spec("dual-focal-classification", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 1.0}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=3)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "dual-focal"}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a multiclass model with Dual Focal Loss

name: Dual Focal Loss for Calibration

parameters.additional parameters: only gamma is accepted in **params; other keys raise ValueError
parameters.gamma: finite nonnegative real focusing exponent (default 0.0; gamma=0 gives cross-entropy)
parameters.ignore_index: integer class label or None; ignored positions contribute zero and are excluded from mean
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point logits shaped [N,C,*S], with C >= 2 and classes on dimension 1
parameters.reduction: 'none' returns target-shaped losses, 'mean' averages valid targets, or 'sum' totals valid targets (default 'mean')
parameters.targets: integer class indices shaped [N,*S], in [0,C) except for ignore_index
